description: Activity history grouped by date: author next to content, context and actions. ActivityTimeline also builds compact widgets. EventTimeline is a compatibility alias. For milestones of a journey, use Timeline.

howToUse: Use it for the history of a record: comments, changes and system events, grouped by day.
Pass the `events` with author and time; set `locale` and `timezone` of the people reading.
Show loading failures with `error` and `onRetry`, and an empty history with `emptyTitle` and `emptyMessage`.
For a small widget, use `density="compact"` and `groupByDate={false}`. In new code, import it as ActivityTimeline.

keyboard.action: Moves through links, actions and "Load more", in reading order.
Opens the link or runs the action.

props.name: groupByDate
props.description: Remove day separators when composing a compact widget.
